title: A Community-Centric Perspective for Characterizing and Detecting Anti-Asian Violence-Provoking Speech

bias_targets.methodology: Collecting a large-scale Twitter dataset using COVID-19 and anti-Asian keywords, developing a community-centric codebook, obtaining crowdsourced annotations from Asian community members, and evaluating the detection capabilities of fine-tuned language models (e.g., RoBERTa, BERT) and zero-shot/few-shot large language models (e.g., Mixtral, Flan-T5) in identifying anti-Asian hateful and violence-provoking speech.
